Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies - from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups - use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

Specialist Solutions Architects (SSA) are domain experts aligned to specific Stripe solutions and customer buying centers. We have in-depth knowledge of specific solution offerings and a deep understanding of customer challenges. We align with specialist product sellers on deals, advise the broader pre-sales team on complex opportunities, support pipeline development and revenue attainment, serve as an advisor on go-to-market sales plays, and provide critical insights to our product and engineering teams.

What You'll Do

You will collaborate closely with sales and pre-sales teams to drive pipeline and revenue targets, while also educating the product and engineering teams on market trends and strongly influencing the product roadmap. You will develop deep relationships with senior customer business leaders and grow Stripe's solution offerings with new and existing customers. As a subject matter expert, you will scale the broader organization by creating reusable assets and coaching others on complex, high-value opportunities.

The team is looking for an online payments specialist with a proven track record of designing checkout experiences and payment flows for B2C and B2B enterprises. You will engage with Stripe's customers as a thought leader in the conversion optimization space, helping them understand how Stripe Link—Stripe's one-click checkout network—can reduce cart abandonment, improve returning customer conversion, and create a more seamless payments experience at scale.

Responsibilities

  • Act as a subject matter expert on Stripe Link to accelerate opportunities globally
  • Demonstrate a deep understanding of checkout optimization, network-based authentication, and the business impact of saved payment methods on conversion
  • Develop expertise with Stripe's Link integration patterns—including embedded checkout, Stripe.js, and direct API flows—and guide customers through key implementation decisions
  • Advise customers on how Link interacts with the broader Stripe platform (Radar, Billing, Connect) to deliver compounding value across their payment stack
  • Define, share, and learn best practices and reusable assets with the broader GTM organization to enhance the quality and efficiency of the team
  • Create reference architectures that help customers visualize end-to-end checkout and conversion improvements
  • Partner closely with the Payments product sales team on Stripe's most strategic Link opportunities, leading solution strategy and owning key customer relationships
  • Partner closely with the Link product team to get early exposure to new features
  • Serve as a "Voice of the Customer" internally to drive product and feature request prioritization
  • Identify and summarize trends in checkout UX, wallets, passkeys, and network-based authentication, and provide actionable insights to product stakeholders and sales
  • Act as an escalation point to drive complex technical issues to resolution with Stripe's engineering team
  • Stay current on competitive analysis and market differentiation
  • Support marketing events including executive briefings, conferences, user groups, and trade shows
  • Approximately 25% travel is anticipated

Who You Are

We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum Requirements

  • 7+ years of experience in a pre-sales, solutions architecture, or technical consulting role focused on online payments or e-commerce
  • Strong working knowledge of checkout optimization, including conversion metrics, cart abandonment, and the UX and technical levers that influence them
  • Familiarity with payment authentication standards (3DS, passkeys, network tokenization) and their impact on authorization rates
  • Experience designing payment flows and integrations for large enterprises, including multi-market and multi-currency scenarios
  • Strong knowledge of software engineering and API integration patterns
  • Exceptional communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills, comfortable explaining complex concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences
  • A proven ability to build strong collaborative working relationships with business partners
  • Ability to deal effectively with ambiguity and thrive in an unstructured, fast-moving environment

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience integrating Stripe or other RESTful APIs into web applications
  • Experience with A/B testing or analytics frameworks for checkout optimization
  • Familiarity with wallet and one-click checkout ecosystems (Apple Pay, Google Pay, PayPal, Shop Pay)
  • Experience as a subject matter expert in a relevant industry, vertical, or product

Who We Are

At OKX, we believe that the future will be reshaped by crypto, and ultimately contribute to every individual's freedom.
OKX is a leading crypto exchange, and the developer of OKX Wallet, giving millions access to crypto trading and decentralized crypto applications (dApps). OKX is also a trusted brand by hundreds of large institutions seeking access to crypto markets. We are safe and reliable, backed by our Proof of Reserves.
Across our multiple offices globally, we are united by our core principles: We Before Me, Do the Right Thing, and Get Things Done. These shared values drive our culture, shape our processes, and foster a friendly, rewarding, and diverse environment for every OK-er. OKX is part of OKG, a group that brings the value of Blockchain to users around the world, through our leading products OKX, OKX Wallet, OKLink and more.

About the Team

The Global Physical Security Team (PST) helps protect OKX personnel, executives, facilities, events, and business operations from physical and security-related threats worldwide.
PST takes an intelligence-led, risk-based approach encompassing executive protection, travel security, workplace and event security, protective intelligence, incident response, security technology, and third-party security services.
The team works closely with internal stakeholders, external security providers, emergency services, and law enforcement, as appropriate.

About the Opportunity

We are seeking an experienced, hands-on Senior Manager, Global Physical Security Operations to help lead and strengthen our global physical security operations.
Reporting to the Director of Physical Security, you will translate security strategy into practical operational measures, coordinate protective security activities across regions, manage security risks and incidents, and help ensure consistent execution of global security standards.
This position requires sound judgment, operational leadership, adaptability, and the ability to make proportionate, risk-based decisions in complex and rapidly evolving environments. The ideal candidate is equally comfortable planning security operations, responding to emerging threats, working with senior leadership, and improving existing security capabilities.

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Global Security Operations: Support the Director of Physical Security in implementing and continuously improving global physical security strategies, policies, standards, procedures, and operational programs, including cross-regional coordination and coverage as required.
  • Executive Protection and Travel Security: Plan and coordinate risk-based protective security for executives and designated personnel, including threat and travel-risk assessments, secure transportation, vetted protective resources, and contingency planning.
  • Physical Security Assessments: Conduct or coordinate security risk assessments of offices, facilities, sensitive work areas, and other company locations. Recommend and support appropriate improvements to access control, surveillance, visitor management, and emergency preparedness.
  • Protective Intelligence and Threat Assessment: Monitor and assess geopolitical developments, security threats, and concerning activities affecting personnel or company interests. Evaluate available intelligence and coordinate practical, proportionate risk-mitigation measures with relevant stakeholders.
  • Event and Corporate Security: Lead or coordinate physical security planning for corporate events, conferences, executive engagements, and other significant business activities, including venue assessments, protective arrangements, security staffing, and emergency planning.
  • Incident Response and Crisis Preparedness: Serve as an operational security lead during significant incidents, threats, or emergencies, as designated. Coordinate response activities, personnel accountability, stakeholder communications, and post-incident improvements while supporting broader crisis-management and business-continuity efforts.
  • Security Vendor Management: Oversee third-party security providers supporting executive protection, guarding, secure transportation, intelligence, event security, and other specialized services. Coordinate vendor selection, suitability assessments, performance monitoring, and service improvements with relevant stakeholders.
  • Security Technology and Program Improvement: Collaborate with internal teams and external partners to strengthen security technologies, threat monitoring, emergency preparedness, operational reporting, and performance metrics. Identify security gaps, recommend corrective measures, and provide clear updates to leadership.

What We Look For In You

  • 7+ years of relevant experience in corporate security, physical security operations, executive protection, protective intelligence, security risk management, law enforcement, military security, or a closely related field.
  • Demonstrated experience coordinating or managing physical security operations across multiple locations or jurisdictions, with practical experience in several relevant disciplines, such as executive protection, travel security, workplace security, threat assessment, incident response, or vendor management.

Nice to Haves

  • Corporate security experience within financial services, technology, fintech, digital assets, or another global or highly regulated industry.
  • Prior experience in law enforcement, military, intelligence, diplomatic security, or another relevant public-sector security environment.
  • Experience with protective intelligence, behavioral threat assessment, crisis management, emergency preparedness, or business-continuity support.

Prime Intellect is building the open superintelligence stack: the infrastructure frontier AI labs build internally, made available to every ambitious AI team.

We are building open frontier AI: open-source models trained end to end for long-horizon tasks like autonomous research, and the full-stack platform our own research team uses to build them. The next generation of AI companies, enterprises, and research teams do not just need more GPUs. They need the ability to turn their own workflows, tools, data, and feedback loops into superintelligence they own.

Prime Intellect has raised $150M in total funding from Founders Fund, Radical Ventures, NVIDIA, and exceptional AI, infrastructure, and enterprise operators — including Andrej Karpathy, Dwarkesh Patel, and leaders and founders from Ramp, Perplexity, Harvey, Mercor, Zapier, Datadog, Cognition, OpenAI, Thinking Machines, Together AI, SemiAnalysis, LangChain, Browserbase, Cloudflare, Sierra, Databricks, Airbnb, OpenRouter, Standard Intelligence, Fleet, Core Auto, and more. We are looking for people who want to build at the intersection of frontier research, real infrastructure, and go-to-market for a category that does not fully exist yet.

Your Role

We are a team of about 60, split between our San Francisco office and remote staff, and we are hiring quickly. Every researcher, engineer, and operator who joins us has a first day, a first week, and a first impression of how seriously we take the people who build here. Right now, that experience depends on a lot of people doing a lot of small things right. This role makes it a system.

You will own the employee lifecycle from the moment a candidate is scheduled for an interview through a new hire's first weeks. You will design every new hire's first day, run onboarding end to end, coordinate recruiting logistics across multiple open searches, and help bring the team together in person. You will also be the person who looks at how this function works and makes it faster, more reliable, and more personal — including where AI tools and automation can take the repetitive parts off your plate so you can spend your time on the parts that only a person can do.

This is an in-person role based in our San Francisco office, reporting to our Executive Business Partner and working closely with the Head of Talent, hiring managers, IT, and finance.

Responsibilities

Onboarding & Employee Experience

  • Design the first-day schedule and experience for every new hire so they feel welcomed and productive from day one, with a white-glove approach for executive hires

  • Set up desks and equipment before day one: laptop, monitor, welcome kit in place; coordinate provisioning, accounts, and tool access with IT

  • Coordinate finance onboarding — payroll, benefits enrollment, expense tools, company card — and office access: door access, building entry, and meal program

  • Complete required onboarding steps accurately and on time: background checks, I-9 verification, employee records, and HRIS setup

  • Identify immigration and visa needs early, route them to the right people, and track them to resolution

  • Maintain and continuously improve the onboarding system so every hire gets a consistent, well-run first week

  • Support offboarding: recover equipment and remove access

Recruiting Coordination

  • Own interview scheduling across multiple open roles so every candidate and interviewer shows up informed, prepared, and on time

  • Book travel and host candidates for onsite interviews and work trials, creating a warm, human candidate experience

  • Keep candidates and hiring teams informed throughout the process with timely, clear communication

  • Maintain Ashby as the single source of truth: stage updates, candidate notes, and pipeline hygiene

  • Own scheduling timelines and SLAs, surface risks early, and keep recruiters and hiring managers in the loop

Systems, Culture & Team Operations

  • Find smarter, faster ways to run this function, including automating repetitive work with AI tools

  • Track open hiring and onboarding tasks and follow through on every commitment

  • Contribute to an in-person culture that builds connection across in-office and remote teams

  • Help plan and run team onsites and offsites, including attendee logistics and travel

  • Take on recruiting operations and sourcing projects as the function grows

What Success Looks Like

  • New hires feel expected and cared for. Before day one, they know where to go, what to expect, and who to ask for help.

  • Laptops arrive on time, accounts work, schedules are clear, and first-week travel is arranged. You check directly with each new hire rather than assuming everything is set.

  • Compliance steps — background checks, I-9s, records — are complete and accurate without anyone having to chase them.

  • Recruiting, IT, managers, and office teams know what they own. You spot delays and resolve them before they affect a start date.

  • Trackers, checklists, and communications stay current as hiring volume grows.

What We're Looking For

  • 2+ years in recruiting coordination, people operations, HR, or a similar high-volume coordination role

  • Proactive coordination: you can juggle many starts, owners, and deadlines without losing the details, and you follow up before anyone has to ask

  • Real care for the employee and candidate experience — a warm welcome is built from both thoughtful communication and reliable execution

  • Comfort managing background checks, I-9 verification, employee records, and HRIS setup, and handling sensitive information with discretion, including for senior and executive candidates

  • Cross-functional follow-through: you make ownership clear and stay with an issue until it's resolved

  • Process improvement instinct: you spot recurring gaps in a checklist, handoff, or message and fix them

  • Highly skilled in tools like Google Calendar, Slack, and Notion, with demonstrated ability to handle high-volume work efficiently

  • Daily liquidity reporting and streamlined data pipelines

Alpaca is a US-headquartered, global leader in agent-first brokerage infrastructure for stocks, ETFs, options, crypto, fixed income, 24/5 trading, and more.

We're deeply committed to open-source contributions and fostering a vibrant community, continuously enhancing our award-winning, developer-friendly API and the robust infrastructure behind it.

Alpaca is proudly backed by $400 million in funding from top-tier global investors including Portage Ventures, Spark Capital, Tribe Capital, Social Leverage, Horizons Ventures, Opera Tech Ventures, SBI Group, Derayah Financial, Unbound, Peak XV, Elefund, and Y Combinator.

Our Team Members:

We're a dynamic team of 400+ globally distributed members who thrive working from our favorite places around the world, with teammates spanning the USA, Canada, Japan, Hungary, Nigeria, Brazil, the UK, and beyond!

We're searching for passionate individuals eager to contribute to Alpaca's rapid growth. If you align with our core values—Stay Curious, Have Empathy, and Be Accountable—and are ready to make a significant impact, we encourage you to apply.

About the Role

We are seeking a Staff Software Engineer to lead the technical direction of our Margin & Risk team, part of Prime Engine. The team builds the systems that protect Alpaca, our partners, and their customers from financial exposure across every asset class the platform supports — equities, options, and crypto today, and new asset classes as the platform expands.

These systems calculate margin requirements, enforce real-time risk and exposure limits, manage margin calls through their full lifecycle, and automate operational workflows that were historically manual or split across fragmented services. This role is expected to work across those asset classes, not own a single product line: portfolio and intraday margin, options risk, crypto risk controls, and the margin models for new products as they come online. Exposure is often cross-asset, so the architecture has to treat a customer's risk as one picture.

This is a high-consequence domain. A defect can cause financial loss, incorrectly restrict a customer's trading, or create regulatory exposure. Latency matters, and correctness matters more. We are looking for an engineer who has owned systems like this before — including what happens when they fail — and who has built that kind of system, not only operated one someone else designed.

You will not manage people directly. You will lead through architecture, code, design reviews, and mentorship, and you will remain a principal contributor on mission-critical systems. The team is about six engineers today and is scaling toward ten. You will be the senior technical anchor for the domain, working with the engineering manager and the senior engineers on the team to spread deep ownership as it grows.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own the architecture and technical roadmap for margin and risk across asset classes, including portfolio margin, intraday margining, options risk, real-time exposure limits, margin-call automation, and margin models for new asset classes.
  • Design and build services that turn complex margin methodologies and regulatory rules into correct, testable, and observable systems, and keep those rules consistent where asset classes interact.
  • Lead real-time risk enforcement on the order path, balancing latency against accuracy and safety.
  • Drive reliability and performance across the team's services: throughput, state recovery, database load, and failure isolation.
  • Partner with Product, Brokerage Operations, Compliance, and adjacent engineering teams (order management, ledger, account, market data) to define behavior and integration boundaries.
  • Set the standard for correctness in a financial system: transactional integrity, idempotency, reconciliation, feature flags, and staged rollouts.
  • Lead design reviews, mentor senior and mid-level engineers, and raise the engineering bar as the team grows.
  • Act as a technical point of escalation for production margin and risk issues, and drive durable prevention after incidents.

Qualifications

  • 8+ years of backend or distributed-systems experience. Evidence of scope and ownership matters more than a strict year count. Strong preference for someone who has owned the same consequential production system for at least two years.
  • Proven ownership of a high-volume system where a defect could cause financial loss, a data-integrity failure, or an inappropriate customer restriction.
  • Experience designing and shipping transactional, low-latency, high-throughput systems.
  • Strong expertise in Go, or deep experience in Java, C++, or Rust and a clear willingness to work primarily in Go. Domain knowledge matters more than prior time in Go.
  • Deep knowledge of relational databases (PostgreSQL preferred), transactions, consistency, and concurrency.
  • Experience with event-driven and service-oriented systems (gRPC or other RPC, Kafka, RabbitMQ, or similar) and with Kubernetes.
  • Demonstrated care for correctness: testing strategy, edge-case analysis, reconciliation, and safe production rollout.
  • Clear communication with engineers and with operations and compliance partners, including when the business rules are complex or still being defined.
  • Track record of technical leadership and mentorship across teams. Curious about the core of the domain, and effective as a teammate.

Preferred Skills

  • Hands-on margin or risk experience in more than one asset class, with derivatives or recently launched markets especially valuable. You would help establish and deepen that expertise on the team.
  • Familiarity with margin methodologies such as Reg T, portfolio margin, options spread margin, or futures margin.
  • Background in brokerage, clearing, exchange, ledger, payments, or settlement systems.
  • Experience with options, derivatives, or multi-leg strategies and their risk characteristics.
  • Experience with workflow orchestration (Temporal or similar) for long-running processes such as margin-call lifecycles.
  • Experience with observability and production performance tuning.
  • Experience leading migrations or refactors in production-critical environments.

How We Take Care of You:
